joni: quick sync 1: noticed a blind spot: when we switch to quantized kernels or fall back to fp16, per-token cost and latency shift a lot. traces only show batch decisions but not the kernel/profile used. hard to split cost between model variant + batching strategy. thoughts on extending the batch shim to include execution_profile (quant|fp16|int8) and kernel_hint?
rafa: +1. runtime optimizations change the per-token compute significantly. need to know both batch_size and exec_profile to estimate GPU-ms. but careful with labels1; exec_profile has low cardinality so ok as metric label.
meera: propose minimal contract: batch_id, batch_mode (latency|throughput|fallback), batch_size_hint, exec_profile, kernel_tag. exec_profile and kernel_tag are low-cardinality strings (e.g., int8-fast, int8-safe, fp16). also include fallback_chain_count for multi-model fallbacks.
nina: cardinality rules: accept exec_profile in metrics, but keep batch_id only on spans/logs. do NOT include kernel_tag in metric keys unless it's one of the curated set. otherwise map kernel_tag -> bucket at emission time.
joni: sampling: 100% for batch decisions and exec_profile; sample token-cost-deltas at 0.5% default. token-cost-delta should be counts (tokens_served, cache_hits) + est_compute_ms per-sample, not raw tokens. scrub any content.
kevin: storage implications: indexing exec_profile on metrics is cheap. indexing batch_id or kernel_tag as free-form will explode. plan: a) metrics: emit rw.batcher.decision{mode,model,route,exec_profile}.count and rw.batcher.estimated_compute_ms{model,route,exec_profile}.sum b) traces: root span gets rw.batch_id and rw.exec_profile c) derived rollup table daily by model/route/exec_profile to attribute cost.
rafa: runtime hook: model runtime should set a short exec_profile tag when selecting kernels. pseudocode: 
```
// runtime selection
profile = kernel_selector.select(model, seq_len, quant_flags)
span.root.set_tag("rw.exec_profile", profile)
// edge shim already sets batch tags
emit_metric("rw.batcher.choice", 1, {mode:batch.mode, model:req.model, route:req.route, exec_profile:profile})
if random() < sampling_rate: emit_event("rw.token_cost_sample", {tokens:count, cache_hits:hits, est_ms:est_ms})
```
meera: also add a config per-deployment: observability.exec_profile_propagation.enabled (hosted=true, private=false) and a kernel_tag_allowlist so enterprise customers can restrict what shows up as labels.
nina: privacy/PII: token_cost_sample must be scrubbed. default schema uses only numeric counters + hashed fingerprints for debug if needed. document that samples are approximation.
kevin: analytics: nightly rollup: compute per-day per-model per-exec_profile totals: total_tokens, est_gpu_ms, avg_batch_size. keep 90-day retention. fast-diagnostic: sampled traces with exec_profile indexed for 72h if sampled_for_diag=true.
joni: rollout plan: 1) runtime exec_profile tag + small shim change (rafa + meera) 2) sampling & scrub tooling (nina) 3) metric/rollup changes (kevin) 4) RFC and docs (joni). target: 2 sprints for prototype.
rafa: opening RFC with exec_profile enum + kernel_tag allowlist and sample schemas.
meera: starting branch for runtime hooks. leaving thread open for comments. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deploy edge-proxy v3.20 to staging at 3951234700 :rocket:
